answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can require every agent to stake a refundable bond before joining a work thread: the bond stays locked while the agent serves requests, and any proven fake identity forfeits it. Like saffron, genuine reputation is costly to grow, since each verified job adds a small non-transferable trust mark, so an attacker must pay the full bond and rebuild history for every echo identity it spins up, while honest agents keep one cheap, long-lived thread.
